title: Machu Picchu + Rainbow Mountain & Titicaca Lake
description: 10-Day Accessible Peru Adventure: Lima, Cusco, Rainbow Mountain & Lake Titicaca. Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime journey through the cultural and natural wonders of Peru—designed with accessibility and comfort at its core. From the vibrant coast of Lima to the ancient heart of the Andes in Cusco, the stunning colors of Rainbow Mountain, and the serene beauty of Lake Titicaca, this 10-day tour offers an unforgettable experience for all travelers. With accessible routes, adaptive support, and inclusive experiences, you'll explore Peru's rich history, breathtaking landscapes, and living traditions—without limits.
slogan: Accessible Travel Peru 🇵🇪 - Making Peru Accessible for Everyone ♿
includes: Accessible hotels (4* hotels with accessible double rooms)
Accessible Vans (Adapted tourism vans for wheelchair users in all destinations)
Special Equipment (Off-Road Wheelchairs, slings, portable ramps)
Official Tour Guides (Bilingual tour guide Spanish - English)
Support Staff (Staff ready and happy to help you)
Tours & Train Tickets (All the entrances to the archeological sites and train tickets to Machu Picchu)
All tours described (All the tours and excursions described in the itinerary)
01 bottle water & snacks (Maybe... you feel hungry during the tour)
excludes: Tips, Meals not mentioned in the description, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, other services

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lima - Welcome to Peru
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Lima International Airport, our team will be waiting to greet you with a warm welcome and provide comfortable, accessible transportation to your hotel in the city. Once settled in, you'll have some time to rest after your journey. Later, we'll meet for a briefing session at the hotel, where we'll go over the details of your adventure, answer any questions, and share helpful tips for the days ahead. You'll also receive any mobility equipment or support devices arranged for your trip, ensuring everything is ready for a safe and enriching experience. From the moment you land, we are here to support you with personalized, accessible service every step of the way. Welcome to Peru—your unforgettable journey begins now!

itinerary.title: Lima City Tour - Contrasts of the City of Kings
itinerary.description: Start your Peruvian adventure with a fascinating tour of Lima, the vibrant capital known as the City of Kings. Begin in the elegant coastal district of Miraflores, where you'll enjoy scenic ocean views and a panoramic stop at Huaca Pucllana, an ancient adobe pyramid that speaks to the city's pre-Columbian past. Then, journey into the heart of the Historic Center of Lima, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the colonial balconies, grand architecture, and charming plazas. Visit the beautiful Convent of Santo Domingo, home to centuries of spiritual and cultural history. A delicious lunch at a local restaurant is included, featuring a taste of Peru's world-famous cuisine. The tour is fully accessible, with adapted transportation and dedicated assistance to ensure comfort and inclusion at every stop. OPTIONAL: After Lunch Tour to the Larco Herrera Museum ($40 per person) or Gastronomic tour and demo class ($70 per person). A day filled with history, flavor, and unforgettable first impressions of Peru.

itinerary.title: Flight to Cusco & Afternoon City Tour - Inca Capital Awaits
itinerary.description: This morning, we'll transfer you to Lima Airport for your flight to Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire nestled in the heart of the Andes. Upon arrival, our team will warmly welcome you and transfer you to your hotel for a brief rest and acclimatization. In the afternoon, begin your City Tour of Cusco, a journey through time and tradition. Visit the sacred Qoricancha, the Inca Temple of the Sun, and walk through the iconic Plaza de Armas, surrounded by colonial charm and lively culture. Then, explore the awe-inspiring fortress of Sacsayhuaman, followed by visits to Tambomachay and panoramic stops at Qenko and Puka Pukara, where the spirit of the Andes still lingers in every stone. Accessible transportation and personal support are provided to ensure your comfort throughout the day. A magical first glimpse into Cusco's living history and timeless majesty.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley Full Day - Pisac, Urubamba & Ollantaytambo
itinerary.description: Today you'll explore the breathtaking Sacred Valley of the Incas, a place where history, culture, and nature come together in perfect harmony. Start your day in Pisac, wandering through its colorful artisan market and admiring the terraced hillsides of its ancient ruins. Continue to Urubamba, where you'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch featuring local Andean flavors. In the afternoon, visit the impressive fortress of Ollantaytambo, a living Inca town filled with stories carved in stone. This day offers not only incredible views but also a deep connection with the spirit of the Andes. Accessible transportation and personal assistance are included to ensure a smooth and enriching experience for all. A day full of culture, flavors, and awe-inspiring beauty—straight from the heart of the Andes.

itinerary.title: Living Culture in Cuper Bajo, Chinchero
itinerary.description: This morning, immerse yourself in the daily life of the Cuper Bajo community, located on the peaceful shores of Lake Piuray, high in the Andes of Chinchero. Be welcomed by local families and experience authentic Andean living culture through an enriching and hands-on exchange. Discover the ancient art of textile weaving—from shearing and spinning wool to learning how they create vibrant colors using natural dyes from native plants, minerals, and insects. You'll also explore their agricultural traditions, learning about the native crops they grow—such as potatoes, corn, and quinoa—and the deep connection they maintain with Pachamama (Mother Earth). The experience includes a delicious traditional Pachamanca lunch, where meats and vegetables are slow-cooked underground with hot stones—a true celebration of Andean flavors and community. This activity is designed to be accessible and inclusive, with adapted support to ensure comfort and full participation for every traveler. A morning of culture, nature, and connection—shared with the warm hearts of the Andes. Optionals: Accessible ATV off road excursion around Piuray Lagoon ($35 per person), Day with shaman, energetic cleansing and payment to the earth for prosperity ($65 per person)

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you'll embark on a full-day adventure to the majestic citadel of Machu Picchu. Early in the morning, we'll transfer you from your hotel to the train station for a scenic journey through the Sacred Valley. Upon arrival in Aguas Calientes, you'll take a short bus ride up the mountain to reach the entrance of Machu Picchu. Enjoy a guided tour of this iconic Inca sanctuary, adapted to your pace and needs, with plenty of time to take in the breathtaking views and history. After exploring the site, return to Aguas Calientes for a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before heading back to Cusco by train and private transfer. Accessible assistance provided throughout the day for a smooth and enriching experience. Optional: Panoramic train service ($100 per person, round trip, includes support staff to assist you on the train), Luxury Hiram Bingham Train service, includes brunch, Lunch and happy hour ($1275 per person, round trip. Includes support staff to assist you on the train)

itinerary.title: Rainbow Mountain Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Join us for an unforgettable accessible adventure to the stunning Rainbow Mountain! This full-day tour includes scenic views of the Andes, local encounters, and a delicious countryside lunch. Box lunch included for the journey featuring native corn, Andean potatoes, fresh cheese, and alpaca meat. Adapted support and assistance throughout the experience. Breathe in the beauty of the Peruvian highlands and witness one of nature's most colorful wonders—safely and comfortably.

itinerary.title: Overland, Cusco to Puno - Scenic Route with Cultural Stops
itinerary.description: Today, travel from Cusco to Puno along one of the most scenic and culturally rich routes in the Andes. This full-day road journey includes several fascinating stops along the way, offering a deeper look into Peru's history and highland landscapes. You'll visit traditional villages, ancient ruins, and beautiful viewpoints as we make our way south toward Lake Titicaca. A hearty buffet lunch is included in a picturesque Andean town, featuring local ingredients and traditional flavors. Accessible transportation and assistance are provided to ensure comfort throughout the day. Arrive in Puno by evening and settle into your hotel to rest and prepare for your Lake Titicaca adventure. Optional: Route Cusco to Puno by Train. Lunch and Folkloric Show Included. ($290 per person)

itinerary.title: Lake Titicaca - Uros & Taquile Islands
itinerary.description: Explore the magic of Lake Titicaca on a full-day boat tour to the floating Uros Islands and the traditional island of Taquile. Start your day navigating the highest navigable lake in the world as you visit the unique Uros community, where locals live on handmade reed islands. Then continue to Taquile, known for its rich textile traditions and stunning lake views. Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch on Taquile Island, featuring local ingredients and Andean hospitality. The tour includes adapted assistance and personalized support to ensure a safe and inclusive experience on the water and the islands. Return to Puno in the late afternoon with unforgettable memories of Peru's living lake cultures.

itinerary.title: Time to say Good Bye...
itinerary.description: After 10 incredible days discovering the soul of Peru—its colors, flavors, landscapes, and people—it's time to say goodbye, but not farewell forever. This morning, we'll accompany you to Juliaca Airport, where you'll board your flight back to Lima to connect with your international journey home. As your adventure ends, we hope your heart is full of unforgettable moments, meaningful connections, and a deep bond with this magical land. Thank you for letting us be part of your journey. It has been a true honor to travel with you. We'll be waiting with open arms whenever you return. And like the Inca's says... TUPAYANCHIS K'AMA! - Until life meet us again... ¡Hasta pronto!
